won.source: The hub's Pristine top tens of 29 April and 11 May 2009 head the list with the champion's name, Zack T (spelled Zach T on 11 May); when he won it is not on any held page.

how: Champion in the rankings of 29 April and 11 May 2009 and billed as champion for ECWA Dead on Arrival on 6 June 2009. Champion when the held pages end.
